notes: AI-assisted manual review (optional, self-configured endpoint/model/key stored locally). Offline by default; the opt-in version check is read-only, multi-source and never uploads table data. Downloaded bytes must embed TOOL_VERSION >= the announced latest. Version check and download retry silently up to 3 times when every source fails. New in 1.3.3: the post-download done step card is gone (the panel simply closes once the file is saved) and the backup / data-carryover hint is now small print on the new-version card. Final answers are always chosen by the native-speaker human reviewer.
